newsitem.title: UK: UK Oct bank mortgage lending up 7.0 pct - BBA.
newsitem.headline: UK Oct bank mortgage lending up 7.0 pct - BBA.

text.p: The British Bankers' Association released the following data for net lending for house purchase by financial institutions in October. (in millions of stg)

The BBA said the number of new mortgage approvals rose 11.7 percent to 41,310 in October. Their value increased by almost 15 percent to 2,412 million stg. The average value of approvals rose to 58,400 stg, some 15 percent higher than a year ago.

"The major banks' mortgage business strengthened sharply in October and improving consumer confidence and the prospects for incomes growth point to a further strengthening of the housing market in the coming months, although increases in interest rates may be a restraining factor," said Tim Sweeney, director general of the BBA.

"Taking the figures of the banks and the building societies for October together, it is likely that overall net lending and approvals data for the month will have been the strongest since the recent housing market recovery began."
